mechanism: Alendronate can cause esophageal irritation and upper GI adverse effects; tolterodine's anticholinergic properties may reduce GI motility and increase esophageal exposure time to alendronate.
action: Maintain strict alendronate dosing instructions (upright position, empty stomach, 30-minute wait); monitor for esophageal symptoms; consider alternative anticholinergic if GI intolerance develops.
